reference_sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku))) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_bad
FROM products
alternatives: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS pct_bad FROM products
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_bad FROM products

other_way.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sku <> UPPER(TRIM(sku)) THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS pct_bad FROM products
other_way.tradeoff: Averaging a flag of 100 or 0 gives the percentage directly, but a count over a count shows where the number comes from.
